title: MAXX returns the largest value of the expression over the rows
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", MAXX ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] * Sales[Amount] ) )

source.quote: Returns the highest value that results from evaluating an expression for each row of a table.
source.supports: the expression is evaluated per row

source.quote: it returns a currency when a currency and a non-currency type are involved

derivation: Quantity * Amount per Sales row: 100, 80, 20, 250, 400, 90, 100. The largest is 400 (row 5: 2 * 200).
